definition: the direct and local food arrangements I mean to cultivate and have not

settled:
What would replace the Smiths and Walmart share is a set of direct or local relationships, the same shape as the local people I already rely on.

Azure Standard for bulk dry goods. A local CSA for produce. A neighbour for eggs and dairy. A share of meat straight from a rancher.

Each is a candidate for a B, and each would reduce the grocery-chain fraction without touching the Costco anchor.

None of them exists yet. Cultivating a relationship takes bandwidth, so this waits on the same recovery the Walmart exit waits on.

title: The Food Relationships I Have Not Built
